mapIdentity.scope: The named cathedral’s outer walls, front endpoints and Plaza 10 de Noviembre establish the model position and direction.

note: The dated 1908 photograph establishes the paired domed belfries and curving south frontage. The authors of the 2017 building survey record three nave doors, the octagonal belfry sections, tiled roofs and the crossing dome.
